title: CD Projekt Red is "targeting" a 2028 release date for The Witcher 4, per a new update from the developer
content:
CD Projekt Red has posted a quick update about The Witcher 4, narrowing down the release date for its upcoming RPG sequel. "This is our biggest, boldest, and most ambitious game to date," says CD Projekt Red joint-CEO Michal Nowakowski, shortly before confirming the studio is "targeting" a release date in 2028. Bear in mind, then, that this could always slip.
